name: Anhui Shenjian New Materials Co.,Ltd
summary: Anhui Shenjian New Materials Co.,Ltd research, produces, markets, and sells saturated polyester resins for powder coatings in chemical materials field in China and internationally. The company offers outdoor polyester resins primarily used in the surface field of outdoor metal equipment, including home appliances, building materials, automobiles, agricultural machinery, engineering machinery, 5G base stations, highway guardrails and general Industrial applications, etc.; and hybrid polyester resin for use in the surface field of indoor metal equipment, including home appliances, building materials, home furnishing, medical equipment and electronic 3C products, etc. It also offers epoxy resin…
